releaseNotes: Dynamic Batch Rate Synchronization: Tour plan travel calculations dynamically pull authoritative Route Batch rates (e.g. ₹2.25/km for SHD-B02)
Immediate Task Provisioning: Approving a Tour Plan entry immediately provisions high-priority tasks in the MR daily agenda with GPS geofencing
Automated Daily Task Reconciliation: Multi-format date normalization ensuring overdue tasks auto-suspend seamlessly once the visit date elapses
Streamlined Rate Management: Removed redundant global rate settings from Monthly TP, consolidating rate policy under Route Batches
Enhanced Storage / Depot Facility Mapping: Dedicated depot geotagging with specialized 50m geofence radius
